subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Are the 14 new action SHAs acceptable for OpenClaw’s token-bearing, release, security-scanning, Docker, and Codex-agent workflows on the refreshed exact head?
rationale: The patch contains no mechanical defect, but accepting changed third-party code with these credentials and permissions is a repository security-policy decision that automation cannot safely make.

options.title: Approve Refreshed Head
options.body: Review the upstream ranges, refresh the branch, and merge the exact SHA after required checks pass.

options.title: Split Sensitive Actions
options.body: Separate Codex, app-token, CodeQL, and Docker publishing changes from routine setup-action updates for narrower review and rollback.

options.title: Hold Existing Pins
options.body: Defer the grouped update until a workflow/security owner can complete the upstream contract and permission review.

recommendation.title: Approve Refreshed Head
recommendation.body: Review the upstream ranges, refresh the branch, and merge the exact SHA after required checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: The timeline shows direct engagement, and recent history connects this person to repository-wide CI and workflow policy.
